name: progress-hud
description: Progress bars above the Claude Code prompt that follow multi-step work, with sub-agent strips and per-task time, token and cost deltas.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Play a chime when a bar needs input, fails or finishes

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the band text; auto follows LANG

nudge.title: Nudge
nudge.description: How hard to push the model to keep the bar updated: off, soft (reminders only) or strict (gate edits and send back at Stop)

sessionMetrics.title: Session metrics
sessionMetrics.description: Where to show the whole-session line (elapsed, cost, context, rate limit)

maxBars.title: Max bars
maxBars.description: Most bars shown at once, 1 to 5

toastOnDone.title: Toast on done
toastOnDone.description: Show a toast with time, cost and output tokens when a bar finishes

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: When to mirror the bar into the status line: auto (only while the band is hidden), always or off

animation.title: Animation
animation.description: Animate the terminal band: a shimmer on the title of a running bar, a spinner, a twinkling tip and a glow when a bar finishes (about 8 frames a second while something runs)
